verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs include a dedicated 'User Memory' feature page, so persistent per-user memory is a documented first-party capability. The pack carries only the page title, though, with no description of how memory is written, recalled, or kept across sessions. Missing for 10: evidence of durable cross-session persistence, evidence that the assistant writes to memory automatically, evidence of automatic recall in new chats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
